note: Jackson County campground on the wooded bluff above Wazee Lake, a 146-acre former iron-mine pit and the clearest, deepest inland lake in Wisconsin (popular for scuba diving). The lake is non-motorized; sandy beach with flush toilets and a concession stand, boat launch, fishing pier and hiking and paved bike trails. Generators need the park manager's approval. ATVs must stay trailered. --Claude
